title: Keep one recovery event and the conditional confidence
statement: Differences of repeated zero-input samples span U except with probability <=delta/2; one sample at each basis state identifies the quotient action. On that SAME event the entire transition kernel is exact on EVERY input,so later finite adaptive reuse does not multiply the statistical failure by task count. Controllability admission never falsely admits a truly uncontrollable promised kernel;for a controllable source, admission probability>=1-delta/2 and conditional model-failure<=delta. This is an admitted-transcript average,not posterior confidence for every particular transcript or arbitrary rare future postselection. Rare wrong-but-admitted transcripts are retained. Numerical execution error epsilon_exec is additional:conditional full trace error<=epsilon_exec+2delta for the stated joint experiment.

requires: Known n-bit coordinates; choose/reset ANY x and observe the complete next state exactly; Y=Fx+beta+eta with fresh iid UNIFORM eta on an unknown fixed subspace U.

No passive-only trajectory,hidden/noisy coordinates,restricted resets,drift,nonuniform noise or arbitrary nonlinear source. Classical controlled consumer stays in the prescribed diagonal/CQ interface.
